text:
Liam O'Rourke: Heads up — three customers received post-bill adjustments this morning. Token tallies arrived late because a nightly compaction batch of metering shards got stuck and replayed after invoicing.

Zara Khan: Which customers and when did this happen?

Liam O'Rourke: Customers: orbit-edge, scriptly, ledgerone. Delay window around 2026-07-02 04:00-04:45 UTC. Adjustments created: ADJ-9401, ADJ-9402, ADJ-9403. Artifacts: s3://redwood-metering/incidents/2026-07-02/compaction-manifest.csv

Eli Navarro: I can take the compaction job RCA. Quick log snippet from compactor-2:
```
2026-07-02T03:59:58Z ERROR compactor shard=47 task=compact - java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException: compaction step exceeded 5m
```
Repro command: `kubectl -n metering exec compactor-2 -- /bin/sh -c "tail -n 200 /var/log/compactor.log | grep TimeoutException"`

Zara Khan: I'll own the billing corrections and customer comms. Draft note: "A scheduled compaction job for usage data encountered a timeout during a maintenance window which delayed posting of token counts. We've applied adjustments ADJ-9401/9402/9403 and are changing the compaction config."

billing-bot: Adjustment queued: ADJ-9401 ADJ-9402 ADJ-9403 status=pending

Eli Navarro: Short-term mitigations: increase compaction timeout, disable compaction overlap during billing cutoff, and add a pre-bill freshness check that fails billing if replay backlog > 0. I'll open PR and test in staging.

Liam O'Rourke: Please add alerting: `CompactorJobDurationSeconds{job="compaction"} > 300` for 2m route to #eng-infra. Also add pre-bill check query to billing pipeline.

Eli Navarro: Action items: 1) RCA + compaction config PR (owner: Eli) - due 2026-07-08; 2) Billing pre-check + alert (owner: Liam) - due 2026-07-05; 3) Invoice adjustments & customer emails (owner: Zara) - due 2026-07-04; 4) Postmortem writeup + artifacts (owner: Eli & Liam) - due 2026-07-10.

Zara Khan: Sending first batch email now and attaching template to /docs/billing/compaction-late-counts.md. Will mark ADJ IDs in billing tracker PM-900 and update when adjustments complete.

billing-bot: Adjustment processed: ADJ-9401 status=completed 2026-07-03T10:12:22Z

Liam O'Rourke: Good. Keep updates here. We'll monitor next two billing runs for recurrence and consider permanent compaction window shifts if needed.
